vocabulary.definition: made impure by exposure to or addition of a poisonous or polluting substance
vocabulary.example: The water from the well was contaminated with bacteria.
The doctor suspected an intestinal infection due to the patient's symptoms.

vocabulary.definition: an organism that lives in or on another organism and benefits by deriving nutrients at the host's expense
vocabulary.example: The mosquito is a common parasite that feeds on human blood.

vocabulary.definition: a disorder in which nerve cell activity in the brain is disturbed, causing seizures
vocabulary.example: Her brother has been living with epilepsy since childhood.

vocabulary.definition: conditions relating to public health, especially the provision of clean drinking water and adequate sewage disposal
vocabulary.example: Improving sanitation in rural areas can significantly reduce the spread of diseases.

vocabulary.definition: contaminated with harmful organisms such as bacteria or viruses
vocabulary.example: She fell ill after eating infected meat at the restaurant.
